text: The retrieved works offer limited direct evidence for the study's hypotheses. The closest prior findings concern the broader misinformation domain rather than AI-generated content specifically: Lewandowsky and van der Linden (2021) review inoculation and prebunking interventions that improve resistance to misinformation, providing a general intervention framework analogous to the present study's design, while Ecker et al. (2022) identify psychological drivers of misinformation belief and its resistance to correction, which bears on H4 (trust in online information). Dwivedi et al. (2023) note that generative AI produces text indistinguishable from human writing, contextualizing the detection challenge addressed in H1 and H5, but do not report findings on detection accuracy or confidence. No retrieved work directly examines interventions targeting AI-detection accuracy, attitudes toward AI, or confidence in detecting AI-generated content.
